# TG16 composite palette data

`src/emu_backend/pce_palette.rs` contains the 512-color RGB palette generated
by Kitrinx's `TG16_Palette` project from `palette.pal` at revision
`e8cdf400f970753ccdf5c17446b5b62eead66e0f`.

Upstream: https://github.com/Kitrinx/TG16_Palette

The palette generator and generated palette are distributed under the MIT
License. The complete upstream license is reproduced in `LICENSE`.
